# CNET

> > CNET provides expert product reviews, buying guides, tech news, and how-to advice across consumer electronics, home technology, and digital services.

CNET is a leading technology media platform covering smartphones, laptops, TVs, smart home devices, gaming, streaming services, and emerging technologies like AI. The site combines in-depth product reviews with news coverage and practical guides to help consumers make informed purchasing decisions.

## Key Topics

- Product Reviews
- Buying Guides
- Smartphones & Mobile
- Laptops & Computers
- TVs & Home Entertainment
- Smart Home & Automation
- Home Security
- Streaming Services
- Gaming
- VPN & Online Privacy
- AI & Emerging Tech
- Tech News
- Apple
- Google
- Amazon

## Core Technology Reviews

- [Tech - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech): CNET's main tech hub with reviews and product recommendations
- [Phones - Expert Reviews, Best Lists, and Pro Tips - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/mobile/phones): Smartphone reviews, buying guides, and comparisons for iPhone, Android
- [Laptops - Expert Reviews, Best Lists, and Pro Tips - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/laptops): Laptop reviews and buying guides for Windows, Mac, business models
- [Desktops - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/computing/desktops): Desktop computer reviews and buying guides for Mac and Windows
- [TVs - Pro Reviews, Best Lists, Format Explainers - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/home-entertainment/tvs): TV reviews, buying guides, and technology comparisons by brand

## Home & Entertainment

- [Home - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home): CNET's home section covering smart home, security, and appliances
- [Smart Home - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/smart-home): Smart home guides, automation tips, and Alexa commands
- [Home Security - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/security): Home security reviews, camera guides, and DIY security advice
- [Kitchen & Household - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/kitchen-and-household): Kitchen appliance reviews and household product recommendations
- [Yard & Outdoors - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/yard-and-outdoors): Outdoor equipment, lawn tool reviews, and yard maintenance guides
- [Audio - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/home-entertainment/audio): Audio equipment reviews, soundbar guides, and speaker comparisons

## News, AI & Emerging Tech

- [CNET: Product reviews, advice, how-tos and the latest news](https://www.cnet.com): CNET homepage with product reviews, news, deals, and tech coverage
- [News - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/news): Tech news and industry updates from CNET experts
- [AI Atlas - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/ai-atlas): CNET's AI exploration hub covering tools, products, and trends

## Services & Software

- [Services & Software - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/services-and-software): Software reviews, app recommendations, and service guides
- [Streaming Services - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/streaming-services): Streaming service reviews, comparisons, and release date guides
- [VPN - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/vpn): VPN reviews, comparisons, and guides for online privacy
- [Home Internet - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/home/internet): Home internet provider comparisons and broadband buying guides

## Gaming & Entertainment

- [Gaming - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/tech/gaming): Gaming reviews, console guides, and PC/VR gaming recommendations
- [Entertainment - CNET](https://www.cnet.com/culture/entertainment): Entertainment news, movie reviews, and streaming recommendations
